correctness.rationale: Replayed all verification-critical scripts green. (1) Smooth K3 + good reduction at 3 + P0=[1:1:1:1]: partials 4*ai*xi^3, coeffs mod3 (2,1,2,1) nonzero, 2+7+8-17=0 — correct. (2) Br=Br1 via ISZ Cor.3.3: independently re-proved {2,3,5} cap H_D empty. 3,5 absent by prime-support (generators supported on {2,7,17}+sign); 2 absent by exact linear equations (e4=0 mod4 from 17-exponent, e2=0 mod4 from 7-exponent, then 2(e1+e3)=1 mod4 impossible). Script hd_check.py uses sign mod4 (overcounts, |H|=128 vs true <=128) but conclusion independently verified correct; cited corollary text verified in full ISZ paper. (3) Six Bright pair-ratios all squarefree -119: replayed br1_algebra.py, e.g. -7/68=-119/34^2 — correct. (4) No Q-ruling through P0: tangent plane 2a+7b+8c-17d=0, section quadratic part (63/2)u^2+56uv+40v^2, disc 56^2-4*(63/2)*40=-1904=-16*119 nonsquare in Q (replayed via sympy) — hence any Q-line through P0 would give Q-point of tangent cone, impossible; rulings conjugate over Q(sqrt(-119)) — correct, honestly limited to lines through P0. (5) Boxed census: exhaustive integer search 25^4=390625 vectors in [-12,12]^4 finds 192 raw/8 projective points (sign orbit of P0) and zero pairs satisfying the five exact line conditions sum ai*pi^{4-e}qi^e=0 — replayed both boxes green; claim is boxed only, not global, as DRAFT limitations state — correct. (6) Hensel subdisc: dF/dx0(P0)=8=2 mod3 unit, Newton lift mod27 for x3=1+3t0 yields 9 logged solutions — replayed HENSEL_FAMILY_OK — correct as mod27 approximations of true Q3 points. galdeg |Gal|=64 context argument (Eisenstein at 7/17 + ramification disjointness) is sound. No density/WA or Br1-generator claim is made. Proof vs enumeration distinguished.

value.rationale: Ordinary full value standard with no preset presumption. Strongest self-contained headline is a proved structural obstruction/lemma for a motivated natural K3 (forced point 2+7+8-17=0, good reduction at 3, low-rank diagonal-quartic frontier of Skorobogatov/Poonen/Ieronymou program): (a) closes transcendental search space (any obstruction, if present, is algebraic 2-primary), (b) links the same invariant -119 across Bright pair-ratios and tangent-cone discriminant to explain refutation of the standard ruling-fibration density vehicle, (c) banks reusable boxed census and Hensel evaluation samples plus certified splitting-field degree scoping future Bright computations. Object and invariant motivated before computation, value not known or mechanically implied, future K3 Brauer-table / descent / zero-cycle work can retrieve the precise fact. Not a textbook restatement, mere substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; incomplete census honestly bounded and does not erase exact headline. Eligible as exact invariant/obstruction under shared standard.
